lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity circular clusters arranged in at least three visible longitudinal rows along the mid-to-posterior trunk, forming a semi-regular grid.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting the horizontal rows of blobs at regular intervals, creating a discernible grid-like anchor system.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent longitudinal ridges running parallel along the dorsal-lateral flank, exhibiting a high-contrast vertical gradient with light upper and shadowed lower surfaces.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Distribution of discrete high-luminance blobs within the first dorsal fin's silhouette, primarily clustered in the mid-to-posterior region of the fin surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant notch or cleft on the trailing edge of the upper caudal fin lobe, located near the distal tip as indicated by the graphical arrow marker.
